status_semantics.not_started: No native implementation/parity evidence claimed by this initial inventory.
status_semantics.source_confirmed: Symbol or module exists in pinned source, not runtime-verified.
status_semantics.requires_semantic_review: Mechanical extraction; exact field owner/behavior still needs review.
status_semantics.not_run: No upstream live session was executed for this row.
status_semantics.not_verified: No native/upstream comparison has passed for this row.

coverage_limits: Source manifest covers every tracked file in listed prefixes; this is not a proof that every semantic behavior is enumerated.
Static procedure extraction does not include dynamically constructed registration names.
Shared schema rows are lexical candidates; nested schemas and field aliases require semantic mapping.
Marketing website and deprecated CLI are outside desktop feature parity; hosted dependencies are tracked as integration risks.
Provider/model availability and third-party authentication must be verified live without printing credentials.
Native implementation statuses are baseline values, not a live reflection of concurrent development.
